result.reason: The redline minimally and appropriately extends the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors, restricts revocation of subscription rights to specified uncured material breaches, and permits successor transfers. However, Section 13.3 applies its revocation exception to “a licence” without carving out the perpetual, irrevocable paid-up licences in Section 13.2. That creates a material conflict with the required absolute irrevocability of paid-up licences. Section 13.3 should expressly apply only to subscription licences, or expressly exclude licences granted under Section 13.2. The phrase “except during a material uncured…breach” is also less precise than stating that termination or suspension may occur only after notice and failure to cure.
